<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. XIIII.|ACCORDING TO S. MARKE.|125 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>{{hwe|ring|hearing}} it, vvere glad: and they promised him that they vvould giue him money. And he sought hovv he might betray him conueniently.

{{verse|chapter=14|verse=12}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26, 17. Lu. 22, 7.''}}* And {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=MAVNDY Thursday.}}the first day of the Azymes vvhen they sacrificed the Pasche, the Disciples say to him, VVither vvilt thou that vve goe, and prepare for thee to eate the Pasche? {{verse|chapter=14|verse=13}}† And he sendeth tvvo of his Disciples, and saith to them, Goe ye into the citie: and there shal meete you a man carying a pitcher of vvater, folovv him: {{verse|chapter=14|verse=14}}† and vvhithersoeuer he entreth, say to the maister of the house, that the Maister saith, Vvhere is my refectorie, vvhere I may eate the Pasche vvith my Disciples? {{verse|chapter=14|verse=15}}† And he vvil shevv you a great chamber, adorned: and there prepare for vs. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=16}}† And his Disciples vvent their vvaies, and came into the citie: and they found as he had told them, and they prepared the Pasche. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=17}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 13, 21.''}}* vvhen euen vvas come, he commeth vvith the Tvvelue. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=18}}† And vvhen they vvere sitting at the table and eating, {{sc|Iesvs}} said, Amen I say to you, that one of you shal betray me, he that eateth vvith me. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=19}}† But they began to be sad, and to say to him seuerally, Is it I? {{verse|chapter=14|verse=20}}† VVho said to them, One of the Tvvelue, he that dippeth vvith me his hand in the dish. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=21}}† and the Sonne of man in deede goeth, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 40, 10.''}}* as it is vvritten of him, but vvo to that man by vvhom the Sonne of man shal be betrayed. it vvere good for him, if that man had not been borne. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=22}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 26, 26. Luc. 21, 19. 1. Cor. 11, 24.''}}* vvhiles they vvere eating, {{sc|Iesvs}} tooke {{sup|‖}} bread: and blessing brake, and gaue to them, and said, Take, {{sc|This is my body}}. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=23}}† And taking the {{sup|‖}} chalice, giuing thankes he gaue to them. and they {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Al dranke, to wit, al the twelue, for moe were not present. Whereby is euident that the wordes in S. Mat. (26, 27) ''Drinke ye al of this'', were spoken to al the Apostles onely, which here are said that they al did drinke. And so it is no general cōmaundement to al men.}}∷ al dranke of it. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=24}}† And he said to them, {{sc|This is {{sup|‖}} my blovd of the nevv testament, that shal be shed for many}}. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=25}}† Amen I say to you, that novv I vvil not drinke of the fruite {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ See Annot. in Mat. c. 26, 29.}}∷ of the vine vntil that day vvhen I shal drinke it nevv in the kingdom of God. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=26}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=THVRSDAY night.}}And an hymne being said, they vvent forth into Mountoliuet.

{{verse|chapter=14|verse=27}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} saith to them, You shal al be scandalized in me in this night: for it is vvritten, ''I vvil strike the Pastor, and the sheepe shal be dispersed''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Zach. 13, 7.''}} {{verse|chapter=14|verse=28}}† But after that I shal be risen againe, I vvil goe before you into Galilee. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=29}}† And Peter said to him, Although al shal be scandalized: yet not I. {{verse|chapter=14|verse=30}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} saith to him, Amen I say to thee, that thou this day in this night, before the cocke crovv tvvise, shalt thrise deny me.<noinclude>{{rh||Q iij|But}}</noinclude>
